excluded_subjects: A level IT; CCEA Software Systems Development; CCEA Digital Technology (NI)
document_text: A level entry requires AAB including Maths or Computer Science, Mathematics (Pure), Mathematics (Pure and Applied), and Mathematics (Pure) and Statistics are acceptable. With EPQ grade A, offer reduces to ABB.

subject_required: A level Maths or Computer Science
additional_conditions: Distinction in specialism component + grade B in core. T level Science or ICT only.
document_text: T level entry requires Science or ICT at Distinction overall, including Distinction in the specialism component and grade B in the core, alongside A level Maths or CS. Contact university to discuss specific core component requirements.

subject_required: A levels AA including Maths or CS
additional_conditions: Cannot use an IT or ICT BTEC
document_text: BTEC Extended Certificate entry requires D in BTEC plus AA in A levels including Maths or CS. IT and ICT BTECs cannot replace the required A level subjects.

subject_required: A in A Level in Mathematics or Computer Science
additional_conditions: Cannot use an IT or ICT BTEC
document_text: BTEC Diploma entry requires DD in BTEC plus A level grade A in Maths or CS.

subject_required: A level Maths or CS grade B
additional_conditions: Cannot use an IT or ICT BTEC
document_text: BTEC Extended Diploma requires D*DD in a relevant diploma (CS, Maths or Engineering) plus A level Maths or CS at grade B. GCSE Maths grade A/7 required if A level Maths not taken.

additional_conditions: Both Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation accepted at HL
document_text: IB entry requires 34 points overall or 6,6,5 in three HL subjects including Maths or CS. Both IB Maths pathways accepted at Higher Level.

subject_required: H1 in Higher Maths or CS
additional_conditions: Minimum H6 in Higher English required
document_text: Irish Leaving Certificate entry requires H1,H1,H2,H2,H2,H3 including H1 in Higher Maths or CS, and minimum H6 in Higher English.

subject_required: Advanced Higher A in Maths or CS
additional_conditions: Acceptable on same basis as A levels
document_text: Scottish entry requires AAABB at Higher plus Advanced Higher grade A in Maths or CS.

subject_required: A levels AA including Maths or CS
additional_conditions: Welsh Baccalaureate grade B acceptable alongside A levels AA
document_text: Welsh Baccalaureate Advanced at grade B is accepted alongside A levels AA including Maths or CS.

subject_required: Maths or CS at equivalent of A level A
additional_conditions: Global Perspectives and Short Courses not accepted
document_text: Cambridge Pre-U D3 is equivalent to A level A. M2 is equivalent to A level B. Global Perspectives and Short Courses are not accepted.

excluded_subjects: Open Awards Access Diploma in Computing and Digital Technology
additional_conditions: Plus 9 Level 3 credits at Merit. Open Awards Access Diploma in Computing not accepted.
document_text: Access to HE requires 36 Level 3 credits at Distinction including 15 in Maths or CS, plus 9 Level 3 credits at Merit. Open Awards Access Diploma in Computing and Digital Technology not accepted.

additional_conditions: IMD Quintile 1 postcode OR time in social care. Applied automatically - student does not need to apply.
document_text: Contextual offer applies to all qualification routes at University of Liverpool. Students from IMD Quintile 1 postcodes or who have spent time in social care automatically receive up to 2 grade reduction regardless of qualification type. Does not apply to Medicine, Dentistry or Foundation programmes. Students do not need to apply - reduction is applied automatically.

additional_conditions: Quintile 1 (Deciles 1-2) is most deprived and qualifies for reduction. Quintile 5 (Deciles 9-10) is least deprived.
document_text: University of Liverpool assesses student postcodes using the Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) across 7 factors: income, employment, education and skills, health and disability, crime, housing and services barriers, and living environment. Postcodes are ranked into Quintiles 1 to 5. Quintile 1 is the most deprived and automatically qualifies for up to 2 grade reduction. Quintile 5 is least deprived.

additional_conditions: Disability declaration triggers individual assessment. Social care history qualifies for up to 2 grade reduction.
document_text: Students declaring a disability at University of Liverpool are referred to the specialist Disability Support Team for individual assessment of their circumstances. Students who have spent any time in social care qualify for up to 2 grade reduction. Does not apply to Medicine, Dentistry or Foundation programmes. University welcomes disability and social care declarations.
